time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 is t = 0
pixel_axes: x right, y down, origin top-left, units px

camera.motion: static (background patches identical to frame 0 within 0.1 grey level in all frames)
camera.view: looking straight down (top view) at a plain light-grey ground / backdrop with strong vignette; dragon seen from above flying parallel to the image plane
camera.perspective_notes: No ground features, horizon or vanishing points. 2D scene: a single px->m scale applies. Mild apparent-size changes (template scale 0.94-1.06, mostly pose-driven; ~+4% during the glide as the dragon moves from x~600 to x~200, possibly lens/radial stretch near the image edge).

objects.name: dragon
objects.description: single dark-grey winged dragon (bat-like wings, long spiky tail, light-grey cone-shaped snout tip), the only object in the scene; head points left (-x), tail right
objects.visible_frames: 0-71 (cut by right image edge frames 0-3: tail tip beyond x=2559; cut by left edge from frame 64: wings/head leave; body point leaves the frame between frames 69 and 70; frame 71 shows only the tail)
objects.reference_point: body_x, body_y = torso/hip centre (the bulge between wing roots and hind legs, on the spine), tracked by template matching; best proxy of the rig origin
objects.motion_summary_px: moves left almost uniformly: body_x 2362 (f0) -> 53.7 (f68) -> -46.3 (f71, extrapolated by tail template); per-frame step 32.4-36.7 px, mean 34.42 px/frame over frames 1->71 (std 1.0); frames 0 and 1 nearly identical (step 0.5 px). body_y gentle bob: 721 (f0) -> 735.6 (f15) -> 708.4 (f41) -> 716 (f52) -> 714.8 (f71). Net displacement f0->f71 = 2408 px, path length = 2410 px.

wingspan_y_extent_max.note: wings fully spread down-stroke start; 1000 at f26, 915 at f37, 870 at f13

wingspan_y_extent_min.note: wings raised toward camera (foreshortened); 317 at f17. Swept-back V pose minima: 502 at f8, 505 at f32

wingspan_glide.note: constant while gliding with wings held spread

x_extent_range.note: bbox length along flight (x) incl. wings; 743 at f33 when wings sweep back past the head; see csv

nose_to_tail_tip_glide_f52.note: snout tip of the light-grey cone to tail tip, frame 52, measured on zoomed image (+-5 px); nose is 182 px left of body point, tail tip 288 px right

events.event: frame 1 nearly identical to frame 0 (body moves 0.5 px); steady leftward motion starts frame 1->2
wings swept back (V), wingspan local min 502
flapping ends; glide with wings spread (897 px) until end
dragon starts leaving the left image edge (wing leading edge at x=0)
body point crosses x=0 (between f69 x=21.4 and f70 x=-12.5)

objects.direction_changes: none in x (always leftward); y drifts down (+y) to f15 then up (-y) to f41 then back down to ~716

static_objects: none: uniform grey background with vignette (darker corners), soft shadow of the dragon offset to the left of it (not an object)

files.tracks/dragon.csv: main per-frame track (body point, bbox, extents, edge flags)
files.tracks/dragon_body_template.csv: torso template match result all frames (valid 0-66; 67-71 invalid, ncc<0.65)
files.tracks/dragon_raw.csv: raw mask measurements (mask centroid, bbox, spine row, rough nose/tail columns)
